title: Speech To Text Service State
description: Transcribes spoken audio to text with a local open-source Whisper model — in the Python runtime via faster-whisper, or in the C++ runtime via embedded sherpa-onnx. (Runtimes: python, cpp; IDs: speech-to-text)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

model.description: Model size: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3, distil-large-v3

language.description: ISO language code (e.g. "en", "de") or "auto" to detect
